title: H=1 Invariant Failure Root Cause (v1)
root_cause: Off-by-one horizon definition in the v1 continuation function. It iterated over future_requests[:H] after the first action, so H=1 actually simulated one future request rather than zero.

example.mechanism: The first future request (id 3034) blocked in the Strict fork but not in the KSP fork.

fix.code_change: Process max(0, H-1) future requests after the first action.
